answer: Give each agent influence only through the diversity of its trading partners: weight a vote by how many distinct verified counterparties the identity has completed paid trades with. A single honest agent can climb the dune of influence only by actually trading widely, like a walnut cracking open only after many small strikes. A sybil army, by contrast, trades mostly with itself, so its marble-smooth cluster of fake accounts stays light: every new identity must pay real fees to real strangers to earn weight, making a thousand fake voices cost a thousand real relationships.
